description.ja: CogVLM2と同じ学習レシピでGLM-4-9Bをベースに開発。EVA-E (4B)ビジョンエンコーダ採用。1120×1120解像度対応。Visual Expert不採用でモデルサイズを13Bに削減。GLM-4.1V-Thinkingなど派生モデルも展開。
description.en: Developed based on GLM-4-9B using the same training recipe as CogVLM2. Adopts EVA-E (4B) vision encoder. Supports 1120×1120 resolution. Model size reduced to 13B by not using Visual Expert. Derivative models like GLM-4.1V-Thinking also available.

description.ja: 標準版。1120×1120解像度対応。バイリンガル。
Chain-of-Thought推論搭載。任意アスペクト比対応、最大4K解像度。28ベンチマーク中23タスクで10Bスケール1位。
description.en: Features Chain-of-Thought reasoning. Supports arbitrary aspect ratios, up to 4K resolution. Ranks 1st among 10B scale models on 23 of 28 benchmarks.
